'''Josiah Halasz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Parker tournament]] on 2 June 2001 with dark side podracing deck, according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2414">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-06-parker-co-6-2-01-into-the-unknownd2414/ parker-co-6-2-01-into-the-unknown], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 6 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-06-parker-co-6-2-01-into-the-unknownd2414/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
